problem: Imagination-based VLN methods synthesize future scenes in vision form (pixels or features of full panoramas), which is computationally costly and carries redundant or noisy detail. LLM-based navigators also often lose text-generation ability through full fine-tuning or use a single LLM branch with no state tracking.
motivation: Navigation needs only task-relevant semantics (e.g. where the 'red sofa' may appear), not full-scene reconstruction, and language is compact and abstract enough to express this. Imagination must also be updated as instruction sub-goals are completed, otherwise it over-emphasizes finished parts.
key_idea: Imagine key future environment semantics in text with a dual-branch LLM (left brain estimates navigation state, right brain imagines candidate-direction semantics), ground the imagination with state via cross-attention, and inject the latent into a DUET-style graph navigation policy.
insight: Both branches help: on val-unseen, the baseline SR is 63, with SELLM alone 72, IMLLM alone 73 and both 75. The direction of interaction matters: state as query and imagination as key/value (SGCA) beats reversing it or plain parallel summation (val-seen SR 75.61 vs 71.79 and 73.75). Attention maps show SGCA up-weighting relevant imagination and suppressing parts tied to completed steps. ATD also converges faster than NavGPT2.
method: State Estimation LLM (left brain): InstructBLIP with Flan-T5-XL, only the Q-Former fine-tuned, distilling GPT-4V navigation-state reasoning from a single view plus instruction (cross-entropy).

Imagination LLM (right brain): same architecture, Q-Former fine-tuned to generate text descriptions of what appears in each candidate direction; ground truth is Qwen2.5-VL-7B captions of stitched candidate-node panoramas.

State Grounded Cross-Attention (SGCA): state embedding as query, imagination embedding as key/value, cosine-similarity attention, stacked layers (4 in the main model); filters imagination by current progress.
Latent embedding injection: multi-head cross-attention fuses the grounded ATD node embedding with the policy's visual node embedding (visual as query).
Graph-based navigation policy: DUET-style topological graph transformer with graph-aware self-attention, trained with BC + PID imitation losses (L = λ·BC + PID).
Training: two stages (brain tuning, then policy); PREVALENT synthetic data added, which the authors say prevents overfitting. The 1.5B size counts only the encoder of Flan-T5-XL.

setting.backbone: InstructBLIP (Flan-T5-XL encoder, frozen LLM and ViT, Q-Former fine-tuned) + DUET-style graph transformer policy trained
setting.training_data: R2R with GPT-4V state-estimation reasoning and Qwen2.5-VL-7B candidate captions; PREVALENT synthetic instruction data for the best model; MP3D scenes
setting.observation: panoramic RGB views per candidate node plus instruction
setting.privileged: none at test time (GPT-4V / Qwen captions used only for training supervision)

numbers_note: Val-seen and val-unseen values in Table 1 are integer-rounded; Table 4 gives two-decimal values for the same models (e.g. XL val-unseen SR 74.63). The XXL row in Table 1's main comparison is not reported; the XXL PREVALENT use is not stated explicitly. The Table 5 (supp.) val-unseen SPL for ATD (65.35) is duplicated from the XXL result, which is inconsistent with the XL row.
results: With 1.5B parameters ATD w/ PREVALENT reaches R2R val-unseen SR 75 / SPL 63 and test-unseen SR 74 / SPL 63, beating NavGPT2-1.5B (test SR 71 / SPL 60) and NaviLLM-7B (test SR 68 / SPL 60), and roughly matching BEVBert on val-unseen (SR 75 / SPL 64) while exceeding it on test SR (74 vs 73) with equal SPL in the reported table's bold marks. It also transfers zero-shot to REVERIE and R4R better than DUET (SR 27.04 vs 24.42 on REVERIE).
limitations: Imagination supervision only covers candidate nodes one step ahead, restricting long-horizon imagination.
Only evaluated in discrete R2R (with small transfer tests); no continuous environments or real robots.
Depends on GPT-4V and Qwen2.5-VL generated labels and PREVALENT synthetic data (without it the model overfits), so hallucinated captions may affect quality.
